status: Manual review specification; not an automated semantic grader or active checkpoint selector
selection_policy: Pending explicit decision before a run; preserve macro development-only recipe unless chosen otherwise
global_criteria: Identify the existing subject/type/context when the prompt specifies an entity; the literal proper name need not be repeated if the identity is unambiguous.
Distinguish real historical existence, being alive/animated inside a narrative, and ordinary biological life as applicable.
Do not deny that fictional organisms are alive within their story merely because they are fictional.
Do not equate animation or agency with ordinary biological life, or with being completely inert.
Reject contradictory verdicts or false supporting facts; flag unverifiable/metaphysical extras separately.
Accept genuine ambiguity/clarification where the prompt lacks enough context; do not impose a single referent on Galatea.
Grade by meaning, not word matching. State reasons and preserve raw outputs.
These are development diagnostics. Run12's accepted assignment score stays 4/10.
